bio.text: Rick Edmonds is a Republican who represents District 6 in the Louisiana Senate, to which he was elected in 2023.
He qualified in August 2026 as a candidate for Louisiana's 6th Congressional District.
He holds a B.A. from East Texas Baptist University and a Master of Divinity from New Orleans Baptist Theological Seminary, and he chairs the Senate Education Committee.

sources.title: New districts scramble candidate qualifying for Louisiana's US House races
